coverTag: A concept for one canal house on the Prinsengracht: twenty-four rooms, twenty-four portraits of the street outside, and a collection that could only exist here.
headline: Twenty-four rooms. One canal house. A collection that could only exist here.
opportunity: The Zetter 717 brings The Zetter Collection to the Prinsengracht: a single historic house, an intimate scale and a street that is itself one of the world's great works of art. We see an opportunity for a collection that feels as if it has always belonged to the house, rooted in the canal, in Delft blue and in the soft light of the Golden Age, yet unmistakably contemporary.

reading.title: Intimacy over spectacle
reading.text: At twenty-four rooms, every piece is seen up close and lived with. Quality and story matter more than size.

reading.title: Story is the luxury
reading.text: Guests should be able to discover something new in each room, and want to see the rest.

reading.title: The street as subject
reading.text: The Prinsengracht itself can become the collection: façades, water and evening light.

concept.title: Portraits of the Prinsengracht
concept.subtitle: Twenty-four rooms, twenty-four canal houses
concept.statement: Each guest room receives its own original work: the portrait of a single Prinsengracht façade, drawn from the canal itself and rendered in Gallery Dutch Art's palette of Delft blue, ivory and evening gold. Together the twenty-four pieces form one continuous street, a collection guests can only see in full by coming back.

pillars.title: One house, one street
pillars.text: Every room tells its own part of the canal; the stair and corridors connect them like the street outside.

pillars.title: Delft blue, reimagined
pillars.text: A heritage palette used with restraint: cobalt depths, ivory light and a single line of gold.

pillars.title: Collectable by design
pillars.text: Every room piece is a numbered original with a certificate of authenticity. Guests could acquire a signed edition of the work they slept beside.

collection.text: Mirrored canal houses in Delft blue, proposed as the first work guests meet, scaled to the entrance hall.
The canal skyline at golden hour, as a still original or as a slow-moving Living Painting on a screen.
A flowing field of cobalt that guides the eye up through the house.
A licensed pattern for cushions, menus or stationery, so the collection continues beyond the frame.

email.subject: A collection for The Zetter 717: twenty-four rooms, twenty-four canal houses
body: Congratulations on your appointment and on bringing The Zetter Collection to the Prinsengracht.

I'm Mariska Beenen of Gallery Dutch Art, an Amsterdam studio creating bespoke art and collections for hospitality. Inspired by the announcement of The Zetter 717, we prepared a short concept, "Portraits of the Prinsengracht": one original work per room, each the portrait of a different canal-house façade in Delft blue, ivory and evening gold, so that twenty-four rooms together form one street.
The concept is attached as a seven-page PDF. It is unsolicited and only a starting point; we would adapt it entirely to your brief and interiors.
Would you be open to a twenty-minute conversation in the coming weeks?

Warm regards,
Mariska Beenen
Gallery Dutch Art · Amsterdam
gallerydutchart@gmail.com · www.gallerydutchart.nl
If this isn't relevant, simply reply "no" and I won't follow up.
